/-!
# The tautological quotient and the universal property of `Gr(r,d)`

This file adds, on top of the Grassmannian scheme `Gr(d,r)` built in
`GrassmannianCells.lean`, the tautological rank-`d` quotient
`u : O^r ↠ U` and the universal property making `Gr(d,r)` the fine moduli
space of rank-`d` locally free quotients of `O^r`.

Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_GrassmannianQuot.tex` (Nitsure §1).
-/

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian

/-! ## Project-local Mathlib supplement — scalar endomorphisms of the structure sheaf

To realise a matrix of regular functions as a morphism of free sheaves of modules we
need to turn a global section `a ∈ Γ(X, ⊤)` of the structure sheaf into a scalar
endomorphism of `O_X` (= `SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf`). On the affine chart
`U^I = Spec R^I` the matrix entries of the universal matrix `X^I` live in `R^I`, and we
inject them into the global sections via `Scheme.ΓSpecIso`.

These helpers are project-local: Mathlib has no ready-made "matrix ↦ morphism of free
sheaves" primitive. -/

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The global section of the structure sheaf `O_X` (as a sheaf of modules over itself)
determined by a section `a ∈ Γ(X, ⊤)` over the whole space, by restriction to every open.
Project-local helper for building scalar endomorphisms. -/
noncomputable def globalUnitSection (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).sections :=
  PresheafOfModules.sectionsMk
    (fun Y => (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y))
    (by
      intro Y Z f
      change (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map f) (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a)
        = X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a
      rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map_comp]
      congr 1)

/-- The scalar endomorphism of `O_X` given by a global section `a ∈ Γ(X, ⊤)`:
multiplication by `a`. Project-local helper. -/
noncomputable def scalarEnd (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf :=
  (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv.symm (globalUnitSection a)

/-- `scalarEnd 1` is the identity endomorphism of `O_X`. Project-local helper for
identifying the diagonal entries of the chart quotient. -/
lemma scalarEnd_one : scalarEnd (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) := by
  rw [scalarEnd, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  ext Y
  change X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
      = (SheafOfModules.Hom.val (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).app Y
          (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y)
  rw [SheafOfModules.id_val, PresheafOfModules.id_app]
  exact map_one _

/-- `scalarEnd 0` is the zero endomorphism of `O_X`. Project-local helper for identifying
the off-diagonal entries of the chart quotient. -/
lemma scalarEnd_zero : scalarEnd (0 : Γ(X, ⊤)) = 0 := by
  rw [scalarEnd, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  ext Y
  change X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op (0 : Γ(X, ⊤))
      = (SheafOfModules.Hom.val
          (0 : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).app Y
          (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y)
  refine (map_zero _).trans ?_
  rfl

/-- The value of the scalar endomorphism `scalarEnd a` on a section `x` over `Y` is
multiplication by the restriction of `a`: `(scalarEnd a)(x) = x · a|_Y`. Project-local
helper, the computational heart of the `scalarEnd` ring-hom identities below. -/
lemma scalarEnd_val_app (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (Y : (TopologicalSpace.Opens (X : TopCat))ᵒᵖ)
    (x : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y) :
    (scalarEnd a).val.app Y x = x * X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a := by
  rfl

/-- `scalarEnd c` corresponds to the global section `c` under `unitHomEquiv`. -/
lemma unitHomEquiv_scalarEnd (c : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv (scalarEnd c) = globalUnitSection c := by
  rw [scalarEnd, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The scalar endomorphism `scalarEnd a` sends the unit section `1` to `a|_Y`. -/
lemma scalarEnd_val_app_one (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (Y : (TopologicalSpace.Opens (X : TopCat))ᵒᵖ) :
    (scalarEnd a).val.app Y (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y)
      = X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a := by
  exact one_smul _ _

/-- Composition of scalar endomorphisms is multiplication: `scalarEnd a ≫ scalarEnd b =
scalarEnd (a * b)`. Project-local; underlies `matrixEnd` multiplicativity. -/
lemma scalarEnd_comp (a b : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    scalarEnd a ≫ scalarEnd b = scalarEnd (a * b) := by
  apply (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv.injective
  change SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (scalarEnd b)
        ((SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv (scalarEnd a))
      = (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv (scalarEnd (a * b))
  rw [unitHomEquiv_scalarEnd, unitHomEquiv_scalarEnd]
  refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ (fun Y => ?_)
  change (scalarEnd b).val.app Y (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op a)
      = X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op (a * b)
  exact (RingHom.map_mul (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a b).symm

/-- `scalarEnd` is additive: `scalarEnd (a + b) = scalarEnd a + scalarEnd b`.
Project-local; underlies `matrixEnd` matrix-multiplication identity. -/
lemma scalarEnd_add (a b : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    scalarEnd (a + b) = scalarEnd a + scalarEnd b := by
  conv_lhs => rw [scalarEnd]
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ (fun Y => ?_)
  change X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op (a + b)
      = (scalarEnd a).val.app Y (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y)
        + (scalarEnd b).val.app Y (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj Y)
  rw [scalarEnd_val_app_one, scalarEnd_val_app_one]
  exact RingHom.map_add (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom a b

/-- `scalarEnd` of a finite sum is the sum of the `scalarEnd`s. Project-local. -/
lemma scalarEnd_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    scalarEnd (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, scalarEnd (f i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [scalarEnd_zero]
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, scalarEnd_add, ih]

/-! ## Matrix automorphisms of the free sheaf

To realise the `GL_d` bundle transitions we promote an (invertible) `d × d` matrix of
global sections to an automorphism of the free rank-`d` sheaf `O_S^d`, exactly as
`chartQuotientMap` realises the universal matrix. The two key algebraic facts — that
`matrixEnd` turns matrix multiplication into composition and the identity matrix into the
identity — follow from the `scalarEnd` ring-hom identities above. -/

/-- `SheafOfModules` over `O_S` has finite biproducts (it has finite products). -/
instance hasFiniteBiproducts_modules (S : Scheme.{0}) :
    HasFiniteBiproducts (SheafOfModules S.ringCatSheaf) :=
  HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts

/-- A `d × d` matrix of global sections of `O_S` realised as an endomorphism of the free
rank-`d` sheaf `O_S^d`: the `(p,q)`-entry acts as `scalarEnd`, assembled over the rank-`d`
biproduct (mirrors `chartQuotientMap`). Project-local. -/
noncomputable def matrixEnd {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) :=
  (biproduct.isoCoproduct (fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).symm.hom ≫
    biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd (M p i)) ≫
    (biproduct.isoCoproduct (fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).hom

/-- Composition of two `biproduct.matrix` morphisms is the matrix of pointwise sums of
composites — the categorical matrix product. Project-local helper for `matrixEnd_comp`. -/
private lemma biproduct_matrix_comp {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ}
    (mM mN : Fin d → Fin d →
      (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) :
    biproduct.matrix (f := fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)
        (g := fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) mM ≫ biproduct.matrix mN
      = biproduct.matrix (fun i q => ∑ p, mM i p ≫ mN p q) := by
  refine biproduct.hom_ext' _ _ (fun i => biproduct.hom_ext _ _ (fun q => ?_))
  simp only [Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_matrix_assoc, biproduct.matrix_π, biproduct.lift_desc,
    biproduct.ι_matrix, biproduct.lift_π]

/-- `matrixEnd` turns matrix multiplication into composition (with the order reversed by
the contravariance of the column/component indexing): `matrixEnd M ≫ matrixEnd N =
matrixEnd (N * M)`. Project-local. -/
lemma matrixEnd_comp {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ} (M N : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    matrixEnd M ≫ matrixEnd N = matrixEnd (N * M) := by
  rw [matrixEnd, matrixEnd, matrixEnd]
  have hcomp : biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd (M p i))
        ≫ biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd (N p i))
      = biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd ((N * M) p i)) := by
    rw [biproduct_matrix_comp]
    congr 1
    funext i q
    simp_rw [scalarEnd_comp]
    rw [← scalarEnd_sum, Matrix.mul_apply]
    exact congrArg scalarEnd (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => mul_comm _ _))
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd (M p i))), hcomp]

/-- `matrixEnd` of the identity matrix is the identity. Project-local. -/
lemma matrixEnd_one {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ} :
    matrixEnd (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) = 𝟙 _ := by
  rw [matrixEnd]
  have hmat : biproduct.matrix
        (fun i p => scalarEnd ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) p i))
      = 𝟙 (⨁ fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) := by
    refine biproduct.hom_ext' _ _ (fun i => biproduct.hom_ext _ _ (fun p => ?_))
    simp only [Category.assoc, Category.id_comp, biproduct.ι_matrix_assoc, biproduct.lift_π]
    rw [Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases h : p = i
    · subst h; rw [if_pos rfl, scalarEnd_one, biproduct.ι_π_self]
    · rw [if_neg h, scalarEnd_zero, biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Ne.symm h)]
  rw [hmat, Category.id_comp, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id]

/-- An invertible `d × d` matrix of global sections induces an automorphism of the free
rank-`d` sheaf `O_S^d`. Project-local — the `GL_d` data underlying the bundle transitions. -/
noncomputable def matrixToFreeIso {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ}
    (M N : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) :
    SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) where
  hom := matrixEnd M
  inv := matrixEnd N
  hom_inv_id := by rw [matrixEnd_comp, hNM, matrixEnd_one]
  inv_hom_id := by rw [matrixEnd_comp, hMN, matrixEnd_one]

@[simp] lemma matrixToFreeIso_hom {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ}
    (M N : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) :
    (matrixToFreeIso M N hMN hNM).hom = matrixEnd M := rfl

/-- **Matrix automorphisms compose multiplicatively** (`lem:gr_matrixToFreeIso_mul`): the
forward maps of two matrix automorphisms compose to `matrixEnd` of the matrix product (with
the order reversed by the column/component contravariance). This is the linkage that turns
the matrix-level Cramer-inverse cocycle into a composition identity of sheaf-of-module
isomorphisms. Project-local. -/
lemma matrixToFreeIso_mul {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ}
    (A A' B B' : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤))
    (hAA' : A * A' = 1) (hA'A : A' * A = 1) (hBB' : B * B' = 1) (hB'B : B' * B = 1) :
    (matrixToFreeIso A A' hAA' hA'A).hom ≫ (matrixToFreeIso B B' hBB' hB'B).hom
      = matrixEnd (B * A) := by
  rw [matrixToFreeIso_hom, matrixToFreeIso_hom, matrixEnd_comp]

@[simp] lemma matrixToFreeIso_inv {S : Scheme.{0}} {d : ℕ}
    (M N : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) :
    (matrixToFreeIso M N hMN hNM).inv = matrixEnd N := rfl

/-! ## The rectangular matrix homomorphism of free sheaves

The chart quotient `u^I` is "left multiplication by the `d × r` universal matrix `X^I`";
to manipulate it under pullback and against the square `GL_d` transitions we generalise
the square `matrixEnd` API to rectangular matrices (`def:gr_matrixEndRect`,
`lem:gr_matrixEndRect_comp`; the pullback naturality `lem:gr_matrixEndRect_pullback` comes
after the scalar atom below). -/

/-- A `d × r` matrix of global sections of `O_S` realised as a morphism of free sheaves
`O_S^r ⟶ O_S^d` (`def:gr_matrixEndRect`): the `(p,q)`-entry acts as `scalarEnd`, assembled
over the two biproducts exactly as the square `matrixEnd` and the chart quotient
`chartQuotientMap` (which is by construction `matrixEndRect` of the injected universal
matrix). Project-local. -/
noncomputable def matrixEndRect {S : Scheme.{0}} {d r : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin r) Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) :=
  (biproduct.isoCoproduct (fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).symm.hom ≫
    biproduct.matrix (fun i p => scalarEnd (M p i)) ≫
    (biproduct.isoCoproduct (fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).hom

/-- Composition of two `biproduct.matrix` morphisms with a rectangular first factor —
the categorical matrix product. Project-local helper for `matrixEndRect_comp`. -/
private lemma biproduct_matrix_comp_rect {S : Scheme.{0}} {d r : ℕ}
    (mM : Fin r → Fin d →
      (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf))
    (mN : Fin d → Fin d →
      (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)) :
    biproduct.matrix (f := fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)
        (g := fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) mM ≫ biproduct.matrix mN
      = biproduct.matrix (fun i q => ∑ p, mM i p ≫ mN p q) := by
  refine biproduct.hom_ext' _ _ (fun i => biproduct.hom_ext _ _ (fun q => ?_))
  simp only [Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_matrix_assoc, biproduct.matrix_π, biproduct.lift_desc,
    biproduct.ι_matrix, biproduct.lift_π]

/-- **Square-after-rectangular composition law** (`lem:gr_matrixEndRect_comp`):
`matrixEndRect M ≫ matrixEnd N = matrixEndRect (N * M)` for `M : d × r`, `N : d × d` —
the matrix product, with the order reversed by the contravariance of the column/component
indexing exactly as in `matrixEnd_comp`. Project-local. -/
@[reassoc]
lemma matrixEndRect_comp {S : Scheme.{0}} {d r : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin r) Γ(S, ⊤)) (N : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    matrixEndRect M ≫ matrixEnd N = matrixEndRect (N * M) := by
  rw [matrixEndRect, matrixEnd, matrixEndRect]
  have hcomp : biproduct.matrix (fun (i : Fin r) (p : Fin d) => scalarEnd (M p i))
        ≫ biproduct.matrix (fun (i : Fin d) (p : Fin d) => scalarEnd (N p i))
      = biproduct.matrix (fun (i : Fin r) (p : Fin d) => scalarEnd ((N * M) p i)) := by
    rw [biproduct_matrix_comp_rect]
    congr 1
    funext i q
    simp_rw [scalarEnd_comp]
    rw [← scalarEnd_sum, Matrix.mul_apply]
    exact congrArg scalarEnd (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => mul_comm _ _))
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (biproduct.matrix (fun (i : Fin r) (p : Fin d) => scalarEnd (M p i))),
    hcomp]

/-! ## The tautological quotient on the charts -/

/-- The **chart quotient** `u^I : O_{U^I}^r → O_{U^I}^d` (`def:gr_chart_quotient`):
left multiplication by the universal matrix `X^I` (`universalMatrix`). It is realised as
the morphism of free sheaves of modules whose matrix of components, in the standard bases
`(e_{i'})_{i' : Fin r}` and `(e_p)_{p : Fin d}`, is the universal matrix `X^I` injected
into the structure sheaf via `Scheme.ΓSpecIso`. Since the `I`-minor of `X^I` is the
identity, `u^I` is a split surjection onto the free rank-`d` sheaf.

Project-local: Mathlib has no "matrix ↦ morphism of free sheaves" primitive. -/
noncomputable def chartQuotientMap (d r : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (hI : I.card = d) :
    SheafOfModules.free (R := (affineChart d r I).ringCatSheaf) (Fin r) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.free (R := (affineChart d r I).ringCatSheaf) (Fin d) :=
  let A := CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin d × {q : Fin r // q ∉ I}) ℤ)
  let R := (affineChart d r I).ringCatSheaf
  haveI : HasFiniteBiproducts (SheafOfModules R) :=
    HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts
  let M : ∀ (_ : Fin r) (_ : Fin d), SheafOfModules.unit R ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit R :=
    fun i' p => scalarEnd ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom ((universalMatrix d r I hI) p i'))
  (biproduct.isoCoproduct (fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit R)).symm.hom ≫

/-- The chart quotient `u^I` sends the `(I.orderIsoOfFin k)`-th basis section of
`O_{U^I}^r` to the `k`-th basis section of `O_{U^I}^d`. Project-local: the column-`I`
restriction of `u^I` is the identity, the matrix-level content of `lem:gr_chartQuotientMap_epi`. -/
private lemma chartQuotientMap_ιFree (d r : ℕ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) (hI : I.card = d)
    (k : Fin d) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := (affineChart d r I).ringCatSheaf)
        ((I.orderIsoOfFin hI k : Fin r)) ≫ chartQuotientMap d r I hI
      = SheafOfModules.ιFree k := by
  set A := CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin d × {q : Fin r // q ∉ I}) ℤ) with hA
  set S := AlgebraicGeometry.Spec A with hS
  haveI : HasFiniteBiproducts (SheafOfModules S.ringCatSheaf) :=
    HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts
  change SheafOfModules.ιFree (↑((I.orderIsoOfFin hI) k)) ≫
      ((biproduct.isoCoproduct
            (fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).symm.hom ≫
        biproduct.matrix (fun (i' : Fin r) (p : Fin d) => scalarEnd
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom (universalMatrix d r I hI p i'))) ≫
        (biproduct.isoCoproduct
            (fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)).hom)
      = SheafOfModules.ιFree k
  rw [Iso.symm_hom, SheafOfModules.ιFree, biproduct.isoCoproduct_inv]
  erw [Sigma.ι_desc_assoc]
  rw [biproduct.ι_matrix_assoc, biproduct.isoCoproduct_hom]
  have h1 : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv) (1 : A) = 1 := map_one _
  have h0 : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv) (0 : A) = 0 := map_zero _
  have hsub := universalMatrix_submatrix_self d r I hI
  have lift_eq :
      (biproduct.lift fun p : Fin d => scalarEnd
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom (universalMatrix d r I hI p (↑((I.orderIsoOfFin hI) k)))))
        = biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin d => SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) k := by
    refine biproduct.hom_ext _ _ (fun p => ?_)
    rw [biproduct.lift_π]
    have hentry : universalMatrix d r I hI p (↑((I.orderIsoOfFin hI) k))
        = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) A) p k :=
      congrFun (congrFun hsub p) k
    rw [hentry, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases hpk : p = k
    · rw [if_pos hpk, h1, scalarEnd_one, hpk, biproduct.ι_π_self]
    · rw [if_neg hpk, h0, scalarEnd_zero, biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Ne.symm hpk)]
  rw [lift_eq, biproduct.ι_desc]
  rfl

    10	/-!
    11	# Pushing a divisor family down to the base, flatly
    12	
    13	Campaign milestone **D3'** (`informal/pic-representability-campaign.md:305`) asks
    14	for the locus over which a Grassmannian `T`-point arises from a degree-`d`
    15	`DivFamily` to be locally closed *universally*, by extending
    16	`AlgebraicGeometry.flatLocusStratification_universal`
    17	(`Picard/FlatteningStratificationUniversal.lean`) "to the family `C × G → G`".
    18	
    19	This file supplies the object that extension has to be about, and records why the
    20	extension has to be phrased this way rather than by relativising the machine.
    21	
    22	## The shape of the reduction, and why it is forced
    23	
    24	`flatLocusStratification_universal` is stated for a module **on the base**,
    25	`F : S.Modules`, with `π = 𝟙 S`. That is not an accident of its proof that a
    26	later session can relax: the whole stratification machine is built on
    27	`Scheme.Modules.pointRank : (X : Scheme) → X.Modules → ↥X → ℕ`, which takes a
    28	module on *one* scheme and a point of *that* scheme. There is no relative
    29	`pointRank` over a morphism, and `chartLocus`, `rankStratum`,
    30	`isOpen_pointRank_pullback_eq` and `existsUnique_factor_rankStratum` all inherit
    31	that shape. So a general-`π` universal property cannot be obtained by adding a
    32	`π` to those statements; the family has to be *moved to the base* first.
    33	
    34	For a divisor family that move is available, and cheaply, because a relative
    35	effective divisor is finite over the base — where a general proper family is not.
    36	Concretely: `Scheme.Modules.HasProperSupport` is by definition
    37	`IsProper (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)` (`Picard/QuotScheme.lean`), and
    38	`DivFamily.properSupport` is exactly that datum for `f = pullback.snd π T.hom`.
    39	A proper *quasi-finite* morphism is finite (`IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite`),
    40	hence affine, and `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat` transfers along an affine
    41	pushforward. Since `O_D` is the pushforward of its own restriction to the support
    42	(`schematicSupportDescentIso`), the family's flatness over `T` becomes flatness of
    43	`q_* O_D` over `T` *itself* — the `n = 0` shape the universal property consumes.
    44	
    45	## What is proved here, and what is assumed
    46	
    47	* `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.of_pushforward_of_isAffineHom` — the **converse** of
    48	  `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.pushforward_of_isAffineHom`
    49	  (`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`), which did not exist. Both directions
    50	  are the same chart computation read in opposite directions; the content is that
    51	  the two `Γ(T, U)`-module structures on `Γ(F, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)` agree, which is
    52	  `Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE`.
    53	
    54	* `Scheme.DivFamily.coherentSheafFlat_id_pushforward` — for a divisor family whose
    55	  divisor is quasi-finite over the base, `q_* O_D` is flat over `T` in the
    56	  `CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T.left)` sense.
    57	
    58	**The quasi-finiteness is a hypothesis, not a theorem, and this file does not
    59	pretend otherwise.** `LocallyQuasiFinite (schematicSupportι x.F ≫ pullback.snd π T.hom)`
    60	says the divisor `D ⊆ X_T` has finite fibres over `T`. Mathematically it is
    61	relative-dimension-1 content: on the curve fibre `C_t`, `D_t` is the zero scheme
    62	of a regular section of an invertible ideal, hence `0`-dimensional. It has no
    63	producer in this project, and `LocallyQuasiFinite` occurs nowhere else in
    64	`Picard/`. It is stated as an instance binder so that a later producer discharges
    65	every consumer at once.
    66	
    67	Worth recording for whoever prices the next step: this hypothesis is *cleaner*
    68	than the one it replaces. `Picard/DivDegree.lean` gates its clopen degree
    69	decomposition on `HasLocallyConstantDivDeg`, a `Prop`-class carrying local
    70	constancy of `fiberDeg` as an assumption and also without a producer. With
    71	quasi-finiteness instead, local constancy is downstream of a stratification
    72	theorem rather than assumed beside it — the same missing geometry, but bought
    73	once and in a form the machine can use.
    74	
    75	## What remains for D3'
    76	
    77	`flatLocusStratification_universal` has exactly **two** binders:
    78	`[IsNoetherian S]` and `[F.IsFinitePresentation]`. `IsQuasicoherent` is a mathlib
    79	instance *from* finite presentation, so it is not a separate requirement;
    80	`DivFamily.isQuasicoherent_pushforward` below is kept because it is the cheap half
    81	and is wanted in its own right, not because `:876` asks for it.
    82	
    83	Finite presentation of `q_* O_D` is `DivFamily.isFinitePresentation_pushforward`,
    84	proved here. `isFinitePresentation_of_finite_sections`
    85	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean`) reduces it to `Module.Finite Γ(T,V)
    86	Γ(q_* O_D, V)` on affine `V`, and that tower is:
    87	
    88	* `Module.Finite Γ(T,V) Γ(D,W)` for `W := (i ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ V`, from
    89	  `IsFinite.finite_app` — this is where the finiteness of the support map is spent,
    90	  and it is exactly what quasi-finiteness bought;
    91	* `Module.Finite Γ(D,W) Γ(N,W)` from `finite_sections_preimage_of_isAffineHom`
    92	  together with `isFinitePresentation_pullback_schematicSupportι`;
    93	* the two compose by `Module.Finite.trans`, and the result transports back across
    94	  `schematicSupportDescentIso` because `Γ(q_* F, V) = Γ(F, q ⁻¹ᵁ V)` and
    95	  `Γ(i_* N, q ⁻¹ᵁ V) = Γ(N, (i ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ V)` are both `rfl`, and the native
    96	  `Γ(T,V)`-action on `Γ(q_* F, V)` *is* `compHom` along `q.app V`, also `rfl`. The
    97	  semilinearity is `Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul`.
    98	
    99	## What remains for D3'
   100	
   101	Two things, and neither is supplied here.
   102	
   103	**A stated bridge, not a free fit.** `:876` stratifies a module on the base and
   104	quantifies its universal property over test morphisms `φ : T' ⟶ S`; its antecedent
   105	asks for `CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T') ((Modules.pullback φ).obj F)`. What
   106	`coherentSheafFlat_id_pushforward` gives is the `φ = 𝟙` case *before* the identity

   109	one line, but a line, and it discharges the `φ = 𝟙` **instance** rather than the

   111	this file and should be settled before D3' is priced as "inputs done".
   112	
   113	**The `∃!` statement about the Grassmannian locus itself**, which is D3' proper.
   114	
   115	Nothing in this file closes D3'.
   116	
   117	## Honest status of every antecedent
   118	
   119	`Scheme.DivFamily` itself has **no producer anywhere in this project** — 135
   120	mention sites, all consumers (measured 2026-07-29, inbox `I-0957`). So the
   121	theorems here, like the rest of Cluster D', are true statements about a carrier
   122	nobody has yet inhabited; that is a property of the cluster, not of this file, and

   124	either, and is *not* derivable from `DivFamily`'s other fields (kernel-checked),
   125	so it is genuine content and not a restatement of `properSupport`.

   729	/-! ## §2. Families of relative effective divisors -/
   730	
   731	variable {S X : Scheme.{u}}
   732	
   733	/-- A **family of relative effective divisors on `X ×_S T / T`** (Kleiman §3
   734	Def. `df:red`/`df:div`, in the quotient encoding — see the module docstring):
   735	a `T`-flat, finitely presented quotient `q` of the structure sheaf of the
   736	relative product `X_T = X ×_S T` with proper support, whose kernel ideal
   737	`I = ker q` is invertible (`Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial`).  The
   738	associated divisor is the schematic support `D` of `F = O_{X_T}/I = O_D`;
   739	conversely a relative effective divisor `D ⊆ X_T` yields the family
   740	`q : O_{X_T} ↠ O_D`.

   742	The source of `q` is stated as the pullback of the unit module `O_X` along
   743	the first projection — canonically isomorphic to `O_{X_T}` — verbatim the
   744	`E`-slot of `Scheme.QuotFamily` at `E = O_X`, so the Quot-family base-change
   745	lemmas and pseudofunctor-coherence functor laws apply unchanged.  The fields

   747	`T`-proper `X_T` (the FGA regime); see the module docstring.

   750	The converse direction described above — "a relative effective divisor `D ⊆ X_T`
   751	yields the family `q : O_{X_T} ↠ O_D`" — is mathematics, not a declaration here:
   752	there is no producer of this structure for any curve, any base, or any test
   753	object, including the trivial one. Measured with the elaborator rather than by
   754	grep: `exact?` on
   755	`Nonempty (DivFamily C.hom (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))))`, with the three curve
   756	binders in scope, fails to close the goal.

   758	Consequences a reader should carry downstream, since this type is the input of the
   759	whole divisor-side development. Every statement quantified over a `DivFamily` is
   760	*true but untested* — it has no instance to be wrong about, and a green build over
   761	it is evidence about elaboration only. `Picard/IdentityComponent.lean` says so

   766	interface. Building the first producer is campaign milestone D1′ (`Picard/DivDegree.lean`
   767	provides the degree slices *of the functor*, not a family). -/
   768	structure DivFamily (π : X ⟶ S) (T : Over S) : Type (u + 1) where
   769	  /-- The structure sheaf `O_D` of the divisor, as a quotient module on the
   770	  relative product `X ×_S T`. -/
   771	  F : (Limits.pullback π T.hom).Modules
   772	  /-- `F` is finitely presented (automatic for an invertible ideal's
   773	  quotient; kept to match the Quot-family shape). -/
   774	  isFinitePresentation : F.IsFinitePresentation
   775	  /-- `F = O_D` is flat over `T` — the divisor is a *relative* effective
   776	  divisor (Kleiman §3 Def. `df:red`). -/
   777	  flat : CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd π T.hom) F
   778	  /-- The schematic support (the divisor `D` itself) is proper over `T`
   779	  (automatic when `π` is proper; kept to match the Quot-family shape). -/
   780	  properSupport : Modules.HasProperSupport (pullback.snd π T.hom) F
   781	  /-- The quotient map `O_{X_T} ⟶ O_D` (source stated as the pulled-back
   782	  unit, as in `QuotFamily` with `E = O_X`). -/
   783	  q : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj
   784	      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ F
   785	  /-- The quotient map is an epimorphism. -/

   787	  /-- **The divisor condition** (Kleiman §3 Def. `df:red`): the kernel ideal
   788	  `I = ker q` is invertible, i.e. locally trivial of rank one. -/
   789	  kerLocallyTrivial : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (Limits.kernel q)

   795	/-- Two families of divisors are **equivalent** when an isomorphism of the
   796	target sheaves commutes with the quotient maps — equivalently, when
   797	`ker q = ker q'` as subobjects of `O_{X_T}`, i.e. when they cut out the same
   798	closed subscheme (same convention as `QuotFamily.Rel`). -/

   800	  ∃ f : x.F ≅ y.F, x.q ≫ f.hom = y.q

   802	lemma rel_refl {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T) : x.Rel x :=
   803	  ⟨Iso.refl _, Category.comp_id _⟩

   805	lemma rel_symm {T : Over S} {x y : DivFamily π T} (h : x.Rel y) : y.Rel x := by

   811	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h1; obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h2

   813	    (congrArg (x.q ≫ ·) (Iso.trans_hom f g)).trans <|
   814	      (Category.assoc x.q f.hom g.hom).symm.trans <|
   815	        (congrArg (· ≫ g.hom) hf).trans hg⟩

   819	  r := Rel

   821

   823	`Over S`: pull the sheaf and the quotient map back along

   828	(`lem:relative_divisor_base_change`). -/

   830	    (x : DivFamily π T) : DivFamily π T' where
   831	  F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj x.F
   832	  isFinitePresentation :=

   834	  flat := fun {_} hU {_} hV e =>

   836	      (letI := x.isFinitePresentation; inferInstance) x.flat hU hV e
   837	  properSupport :=
   838	    Modules.HasProperSupport.of_isPullback (quotBaseSquare π ψ) x.F
   839	      x.isFinitePresentation x.properSupport
   840	  q := (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ)
   841	      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv ≫
   842	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map x.q
   843	  epi :=
   844	    @CategoryTheory.epi_comp _ _ _ _ _
   845	      (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ)
   846	        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv inferInstance
   847	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).map x.q)
   848	      (@CategoryTheory.Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _
   849	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)) inferInstance _ _ x.q x.epi)

   884	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   885	/-- The **relative-divisor functor** `Div_{X/S}` (Kleiman §3 Def. `df:div`):
   886	the contravariant functor `(Sch/S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u+1)` sending an `S`-scheme
   887	`T → S` to the set of relative effective divisors on `X_T/T` — encoded as
   888	equivalence classes of families of invertible-kernel quotients of `O_{X_T}`
   889	(`Scheme.DivFamily`; two families are identified iff `ker q = ker q'`, i.e.
   890	iff they cut out the same divisor) — and a morphism to the pullback of
   891	families (`DivFamily.pullbackAlong`).  The identity and composition laws are
   892	the pseudofunctor coherence laws of the module pullback, packaged as
   893	`Scheme.Modules.pullback_id_app_coherence` and
   894	`Scheme.Modules.pullback_comp_app_coherence_inv` in `QuotFunctorDef.lean`. -/
   895	noncomputable def DivFunctor (π : X ⟶ S) :
   896	    (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1) where
   897	  obj T := Quotient (DivFamily.setoid π T.unop)
   898	  map {T T'} g := TypeCat.ofHom (Quotient.map (DivFamily.pullbackAlong g.unop)
   899	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamily.pullbackAlong_rel g.unop h))
   900	  map_id T := by
   901	    ext z
   902	    induction z using Quotient.ind with
   903	    | _ x =>
   904	      change Quotient.mk _ (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (𝟙 T.unop) x) = Quotient.mk _ x
   905	      refine Quotient.sound ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_id π T.unop)).app x.F ≪≫
   906	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app x.F, ?_⟩
   907	      change ((pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π (𝟙 T.unop))
   908	            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv ≫
   909	          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π (𝟙 T.unop))).map x.q) ≫
   910	          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_id π T.unop)).hom.app x.F ≫
   911	          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).hom.app x.F
   912	        = x.q
   913	      rw [Category.assoc,
   914	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_id π T.unop)).hom.naturality_assoc x.q,
   915	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).hom.naturality x.q]
   916	      have key := Scheme.Modules.pullback_id_app_coherence (quotBaseMap_id π T.unop)
   917	        (quotBaseMap_fst π (𝟙 T.unop)) (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
   918	      simp only [pullbackTriangleIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc]
   919	      rw [reassoc_of% key]
   920	      rfl
   921	  map_comp {T T' T''} g h := by
   922	    ext z
   923	    induction z using Quotient.ind with
   924	    | _ x =>
   925	      change Quotient.mk _ (DivFamily.pullbackAlong (h.unop ≫ g.unop) x)
   926	        = Quotient.mk _ (DivFamily.pullbackAlong h.unop (DivFamily.pullbackAlong g.unop x))
   927	      refine Quotient.sound
   928	        ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_comp π g.unop h.unop)).app x.F ≪≫
   929	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (quotBaseMap π h.unop) (quotBaseMap π g.unop)).app
   930	            x.F).symm, ?_⟩
   931	      change ((pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π (h.unop ≫ g.unop))
   932	            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv ≫

   936	            x.F
   937	        = (pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π h.unop)
   938	            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv ≫
   939	          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π h.unop)).map
   940	            ((pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π g.unop)
   941	              (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv ≫
   942	              (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π g.unop)).map x.q)
   943	      rw [Category.assoc,
   944	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (quotBaseMap_comp π g.unop h.unop)).hom.naturality_assoc
   945	          x.q,
   946	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (quotBaseMap π h.unop)
   947	          (quotBaseMap π g.unop)).inv.naturality x.q]
   948	      have key := Scheme.Modules.pullback_comp_app_coherence_inv
   949	        (quotBaseMap π h.unop) (quotBaseMap π g.unop)
   950	        (quotBaseMap_comp π g.unop h.unop) (pullback.fst π T.unop.hom)
   951	        (quotBaseMap_fst π g.unop) (quotBaseMap_fst π (h.unop ≫ g.unop))
   952	        (quotBaseMap_fst π h.unop) (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
   953	      simp only [pullbackTriangleIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc,
   954	        Functor.map_comp]
   955	      rw [reassoc_of% key]
   956	      simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
   957	      rfl
